resources.string: Embedded VideoLAN LibVLC engine. No external VLC app required. Sources needing protected headers or split audio use ExoPlayer automatically.
Built-in VLC playback powered by VideoLAN LibVLC 3.7.8. Copyright VideoLAN and VLC authors. Source and license information: code.videolan.org/videolan/libvlcjni
